using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests.Windows/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=LocalDb&min=LocalDb&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();

        // LocalDb: builds the template database once, so each test can clone it in milliseconds
        // instead of creating a schema of its own.
        // It runs after InitializePlugins() because the base class expects the Verify plugins,
        // Verify.EntityFramework among them, to be registered before the template is built.
        // It does not pass the EF model to Verify.EntityFramework, so an explicit
        // VerifyEntityFramework.Initialize(GetDbModel()) is still what enables
        // IgnoreNavigationProperties() without arguments.
        EfLocalDbXunitV3.LocalDbTestBase<LocalDbContext>.Initialize();
        // LocalDb prefixes its instance name with chatbot_ when the tests run under an AI CLI, which
        // would otherwise show up in any snapshot holding a connection string or a data source.
        VerifierSettings.ScrubReplace("chatbot_", "");
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests.Windows/Extensions/LocalDbTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=LocalDb&min=LocalDb&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
// LocalDb (EfLocalDb): Gives each test its own SQL Server LocalDB database, cloned from a template, with Verify.EntityFramework folded in.
// https://github.com/SimonCropp/LocalDb
// Note: LocalDbTestBase<T> lives in a namespace named after the test framework, such as
// EfLocalDbNunit or EfLocalDbMSTest; each package imports it as a global using.
// Note: LocalDbTestBase<T>.Initialize() throws when the run uses --report-trx; call it from
// assembly setup instead of a module initializer in that case (plan A9, retired by U15).
// Note: LocalDbTestBase<T> does not pass the EF model to Verify.EntityFramework, so the explicit
// VerifyEntityFramework.Initialize(GetDbModel()) call stays (plan A9).
// Note: The base class also gives ArrangeData, ActData and AssertData, which throw when a phase is
// used out of order, plus VerifyEntity and VerifyEntities.
// Note: [NewDb], [PooledDb], [SharedDb] and [SharedDbWithTransaction] choose the database
// lifecycle per test.
// Note: Calling Build() once and sharing the connection string defeats the template cloning: every
// test then shares one database and has to clean up after itself.
// Note: SqlLocalDB only exists on Windows, so the samples go in the Windows test project.
// Note: Fixie and Expecto get the plain EfLocalDb package: no base class ships for them, so no
// samples are generated.
public class LocalDbTests
{
    // Build() clones the template into a database named after this test, so nothing has to be
    // cleaned up and tests never see each other's rows.
    // The rows come back from a real SQL Server, so the snapshot covers what the database
    // stored rather than what the in-memory provider would have returned.
    // Not run by default: needs a SQL Server LocalDB installation, which a build agent does not have
    // by default.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a SQL Server LocalDB installation, which a build agent does not have by default.")]
    public async Task AddAndVerify()
    {
        await using var database = await sqlInstance.Build();

        await using (var data = database.NewDbContext())
        {
            data.Add(
                new StockItem
                {
                    Name = "the name"
                });
            await data.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        await using var reader = database.NewDbContext();
        await Verify(reader.StockItems);
    }

    // One instance per class: building the template is the expensive part, and every
    // Build() call clones it. The EfLocalDb namespace is a global using the package adds.
    static SqlInstance<LocalDbContext> sqlInstance = new(_ => new(_.Options));
}

==== interactions

Warning external-tool: LocalDb needs SQL Server LocalDB: part of SQL Server Express LocalDB. LocalDb starts and stops the instance itself, but the SqlLocalDB installation has to exist.
